profile_takeaway.description: The single most important point for the reader's project, one sentence; empty string if none

topic_updates.description: Updated cumulative 'known' summary for each tracked topic that had a follow-up today

known.description: Cumulative key facts, at most two sentences

summary.description: One sentence: what it is plus the key number or point

profile_note.description: One sentence for the reader's project (which part, what to do); only for 4+ stars and real relevance, else empty string

followup_of.description: Tracked topic id if this is a new development of it, else empty string

what_new.description: If followup_of is set: what is new versus 'known', one sentence; else empty string

track_topic.description: For new 4+ star events worth following: a short topic name; else empty string
